checkpoint.selection: Already fixed final step 1000; no new checkpoint selection, retraining or optimizer construction
checkpoint.loading: Existing CPU weights_only=True state_dict load, strict keys/shapes/finite values, eval and no_grad; optimizer state is neither loaded nor executed

split.order: Fit in increasing row order; complement in increasing original fixture index
split.definition: Disjoint complement of the 16 optimization examples within the existing 160-fixture family; no new rows/columns, random seeds or reserved test split
split.priorExposure: All 160 fixtures were already inspected with reference/DFS in the simulator; the frozen CNN has only optimized the 16 fit examples. This is not a pristine held-out benchmark

input.selection: Unchanged full legal-list raw argmax; first legal index on ties
input.shortcut: Outcome index 52 clearedRows/16 remains; even complete transfer cannot prove spatial reasoning or residual necessity

materialization.fit: Read original 16 stored examples byte-for-byte; do not regenerate or edit original dataset
materialization.transfer: Future separate isolated 144-example artifact only, using unchanged pointFixtures, encodeDecision, actionOutcome, encodeFootprints and complete unique pointReference labels
materialization.preflight: Validate full 160-index partition, target coordinates, finite schema, exact legal order and unique complete reference before creating the model; STOP on mismatch

forwardBudget.order: fit-control16 exact to stored candidate final logits/metrics -> transfer144 -> fit-repeat16 -> transfer-repeat144; STOP before transfer on control mismatch

resources.runtime: Existing CPU PyTorch only; no install, GPU, new runtime, service or external transmission
resources.failure: Pre-call global/phase/example ledger, exclusive new output, STOP on hash/load/control/finite/schema/reference/repeat/budget failure; retain partial data, no retry or tuning

screening.technical: Exact checkpoint bytes/logical weights, original fit data/predictions replay, fixed 16/144 partition, full legal order, 320-call pre-ledger, immutable sources and exact repeated logits/predictions; model/control failure blocks transfer verdict
screening.rule: Require all 144 correct AND mean NLL <= 0.05 AND every target margin strictly > 0; separate technical PASS, fit replay PASS and transfer PASS/FAIL. No threshold tuning, metric-based model selection or merging fit examples into the transfer denominator
screening.descriptive: Separate fit16 and transfer144 metrics; row/column counts, top1, target ranks, margins and NLL; report nonfinite/abstention as technical failure, not excluded observations
screening.interpretation: Same-family untrained board/target combinations with all rows/columns already covered in fitting. No out-of-distribution, action-kind, broad train/dev repair, calibration, rollout, survival, spatial-mechanism or app-adoption claim
